title.en: Wanting to Talk When You Are Both Tired

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构成年读者把取消计划后的感受先写成一条草稿，问对方是否愿意稍后看，而不预设必须马上回复。对方可以说现在不想接收，读者也可以删掉草稿、只说需要安静。想被理解、愿意分享和有人有余力倾听是不同条件，不由均分替代，也不需要展示私人消息来证明。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional adult drafts a feeling about a cancelled plan and asks whether the other person wants to read it later, without requiring an immediate reply. The recipient may decline, and the reader may delete the draft or simply ask for quiet. Wanting understanding, choosing to share and having capacity to listen are different conditions; a mean replaces none and requires no private messages as proof.

title.zh: 一个可以不采用的对话开场
title.en: An Optional Opening for a Conversation

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“表达者愿意说什么，倾听者现在愿意接收什么，哪些可以保持不说？”可以只讨论上面的虚构成年人，把愿望、当下条件和已同意的安排分别说明。参与者可以不同意、拒绝或结束，不用披露真实经历、数值或他人信息；未得到双方自愿同意的安排可以保持未定。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What does the speaker want to say, what does the listener want to receive now, and what can remain unsaid?” Discuss only the fictional adults, distinguishing wishes, present conditions and agreed arrangements. Participants may disagree, decline or stop without real experiences, numbers or another person’s information. An arrangement without both people’s voluntary agreement can remain undecided.

title.zh: 来源、网页隐私与再次作答

paragraphs.zh: 补充情境和讨论提示由费马测试编辑部原创，只用于成年人当前能确认的互动偏好与条件；不要求有伴侣、披露身份或回想私人经历，也没有固定回顾天数。二十四题按连续四组六题直接计分，无反向题。1完全不符合、2比较不符合、3不确定或视情况、4比较符合、5非常符合；3是数值回答，不是不计分，更不是频率或强度的中点。网页二十四项均选数字或明确不计分后完成；空白与明确不计分不同。每组六项数值齐全才显示原始和6—30及和除以六的四位小数均分；29÷6显示4.8333。只要一项不计分，所属组不显示个人原始和与均分，其他完整组保留；全部不计分仍可完成并读四篇全文，不补零、中点或缩小分母。原小程序要求二十四题数值完整，与网页分组完整度规则分开说明。四组含不同愿望、做法和条件，不合总分、相减、排名、配型或认定统计独立；相同均分不说明心理含义相同，更高符合程度不表示更成熟、更想接触、更愿公开或陪伴更多。题本与英文工作译文尚未建立信效度、常模、跨语言等价或有意义变化阈值。讨论与练习均可略过，不要求联系、说服、实践接触或展示答卷；任何偏好和数值都不替代他人当下自愿、具体、可撤回的同意。网页只保留当前页面内存，没有草稿或最终结果缓存；修改、重测、退出与离开按现有流程清除结果，复制仅四篇公开指南标题与链接，不含答案或个人数值。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additional scenes and prompts for adults’ currently confirmable interaction preferences and conditions. They require no partner, identity disclosure or private history, and use no fixed recall period. Four consecutive six-item groups are direct-scored without reversal. Choices are 1 Does not fit at all, 2 Mostly does not fit, 3 Uncertain or depends on the situation, 4 Mostly fits and 5 Fits very well. Three is numeric, rather than unscored or a midpoint of frequency or intensity. All 24 need a number or explicit unscored choice to finish; blank differs from unscored. Each group needs six numeric answers to show its raw sum of 6–30 and the sum divided by six to four decimals; 29 ÷ 6 displays 4.8333. One unscored answer withholds only that group’s personal sum and mean, preserving other complete groups. An all-unscored attempt can finish and read all four guides without zero, midpoint or smaller-denominator substitution. The original Mini’s all-24-numeric requirement is distinguished from this web group-completeness policy. Different wishes, practices and conditions are neither combined, subtracted, ranked nor typed, and separate calculation establishes no statistical independence. Equal means need not have equal psychological meaning. Greater agreement means no greater maturity, contact, publicity or time together. Reliability, validity, norms, language equivalence and meaningful-change thresholds remain unestablished for the bank and working English translation. Discussion and exercises may be declined, without contact, persuasion, physical practice or showing answers. Preferences and numbers replace no person’s present, voluntary, specific and withdrawable consent. The page retains memory-only answers without drafts or final-result caches. Editing, retaking, exiting and leaving follow the existing clearing flow. Copying includes only four public guide titles and links, without answers or personal values.

title.zh: 回家时的一次普通问候
title.en: An Ordinary Greeting on Arriving Home

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：两位虚构成年人在公共活动碰面，一人选择点头问候并说想留些距离。另一人接受这个安排，不用以前见面时的互动或测试答案要求靠近。即使已经开始交谈，也可暂停、离开或改变距离；这里无需进行任何身体练习，也不从拒绝推断冷淡、经历或整段关系的意义。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Two fictional adults meet at a public activity. One chooses a nod and says they want some space. The other accepts, without invoking an earlier meeting or test answers to request closeness. Conversation can still pause, end or change distance. No physical exercise is needed, and refusal reveals no coldness, history or meaning of the whole relationship.

title.zh: 先约定一种容易使用的暂停方式
title.en: Choose an Easy Way to Ask for a Pause

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“当下明确愿意的互动是什么，如何让暂停被直接尊重，而不要求解释？”可以只讨论上面的虚构成年人，把愿望、当下条件和已同意的安排分别说明。参与者可以不同意、拒绝或结束，不用披露真实经历、数值或他人信息；未得到双方自愿同意的安排可以保持未定。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which interaction is clearly wanted now, and how can a pause be respected without requiring an explanation?” Discuss only the fictional adults, distinguishing wishes, present conditions and agreed arrangements. Participants may disagree, decline or stop without real experiences, numbers or another person’s information. An arrangement without both people’s voluntary agreement can remain undecided.

title.zh: 想一起过周末，也想留一点独处
title.en: A Shared Weekend with Some Time Alone

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：两位虚构成年人约在同一空间各做自己的事，后来一人想聊天，另一人希望继续安静。双方可以分别说明想要与能提供的时间，不把同处一室当作已同意随时回应。可以另约，也可以暂不安排；这不是陪伴与独立的二选一，更不需要检查对方独处时在做什么。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Two fictional adults arrange to work separately in the same space. Later one wants conversation while the other wants quiet. Each can distinguish desired time from available time, without treating a shared room as agreement to be constantly responsive. Another time or no arrangement is possible. This neither forces a company–independence choice nor requires checking what someone does alone.

title.zh: 用三项信息说清一个安排
title.en: Describe One Arrangement with Three Pieces of Information

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪些时间双方已经同意，哪些仍是愿望或未定，安静是否也得到尊重？”可以只讨论上面的虚构成年人，把愿望、当下条件和已同意的安排分别说明。参与者可以不同意、拒绝或结束，不用披露真实经历、数值或他人信息；未得到双方自愿同意的安排可以保持未定。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which times are already agreed, which are wishes or undecided, and is quiet also respected?” Discuss only the fictional adults, distinguishing wishes, present conditions and agreed arrangements. Participants may disagree, decline or stop without real experiences, numbers or another person’s information. An arrangement without both people’s voluntary agreement can remain undecided.

title.zh: 一张合照，包含几个不同决定
title.en: One Shared Photo Contains Several Decisions

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：两位虚构成年人准备参加朋友聚会，先商量是否介绍彼此的关系、采用什么称呼、面对哪些人。一人暂时不愿介绍关系，双方可只用名字或不作介绍；任何方案仍需各自愿意。曾在别处公开，不覆盖这次人群和内容，也不要求解释身份或用披露来证明重视。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Two fictional adults plan to meet friends and discuss whether to mention their relationship, which description to use and to whom. One does not want a relationship introduction now, so using names or making no introduction can be considered, with each person’s agreement. Publicity elsewhere covers neither this audience nor this content and requires no identity explanation or proof of care through disclosure.

title.zh: 把表达分成三类，再留出未定项
title.en: Separate Three Sharing Categories and Leave Room for Uncertainty

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这次准备说什么、对谁说，哪些信息没有得到当事人同意？”可以只讨论上面的虚构成年人，把愿望、当下条件和已同意的安排分别说明。参与者可以不同意、拒绝或结束，不用披露真实经历、数值或他人信息；未得到双方自愿同意的安排可以保持未定。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What would be said this time, to whom, and which information lacks the person’s agreement?” Discuss only the fictional adults, distinguishing wishes, present conditions and agreed arrangements. Participants may disagree, decline or stop without real experiences, numbers or another person’s information. An arrangement without both people’s voluntary agreement can remain undecided.
